svg.title: Quantum Shield (Quantum_Shield)
svg.desc: TLS and post-quantum readiness of 1,069 domains behind 718 Android apps. Custom TLS scanner with a hybrid-PQC probe, weak-configuration checks mapped to CVEs, clustering and Random Forest analysis of scan results. Team project · ENSI PCD · my role: team lead (data collection, most of the backend, the TLS tester).
